unlisted_practices: Protocol-constrained multi-agent reasoning with a manually curated Global Protocol of physiological state-transition rules
Compact persistent patient-state memory instead of repeated serialization of patient histories
Auditor agent staged reasoning (Router, Reasoner, Auditor, Steward) to improve temporal consistency and calibration

screen.reason: The study proposes and evaluates Vital Trace, a new protocol-constrained multi-agent LLM framework for clinical risk prediction over ICU trajectories benchmarked on MIMIC-IV and eICU.
